text: DAZN Bet Club sits on DAZN, the sports-streaming group that is wholly owned by Access Industries, Len Blavatnik's privately held global investment company, where DAZN appears as a portfolio holding. There is no state stake - Blavatnik's money is private family capital, though Access has historically held Russia-linked assets. Human-rights relevance is gambling licensing and sports-rights economics.
